subject: Next steps & econ check — Parcellytics pilot extension request
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma@parcellytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Parcellytics — post-demo econ / follow-up

Hi Emma — great to meet today, thanks for walking us through the routing use case. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can align on pilot economics before you spin up heavy traffic:

- Expected steady-state token volume: you mentioned ~3M tokens/month for entity extraction with spikes up to ~6M on peak days.
- Target unit: you said your finance team is looking for a target in the ballpark of $800–$1,000 per 1M tokens (inference).
- Current runway: you estimated a $20k/month budget for the POC.

Next steps I propose:
1) Can you confirm an expected daily peak and the portion of queries that need low-latency (sub-250ms) vs batch?
2) Can we extend the pilot 30 days (current credits expire in 14 days) and top-up the trial with an additional token allocation so you can validate peak behavior?

I attached a short pilot plan (parcellytics-pilot-plan.xlsx) with suggested guardrails for caching + batch settings that keep cost predictable. If finance wants a target $/1M to evaluate, we can line up a modeled $/1M at three operating points (standard, quantized, cached).

If you confirm volumes and agree to a mid-pilot checkpoint (2 weeks in), I’ll request a one-off credit bump from finance.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

---
Attachment: parcellytics-pilot-plan.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB)
From: Emma Li <emma@parcellytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Parcellytics — post-demo econ / follow-up

Ben — thanks for the recap and the deck. Quick answers from our side:

- Confirming steady-state ~3M tokens/month. Peak days (black friday-like spikes) could reach ~6M but those are rare — more common peaks are ~4–4.5M.
- Latency mix: roughly 70% can be batched (soft latency OK), 30% require low-latency inference (~<250ms).
- Finance target: Tim (Cc) is pushing for ~ $900 / 1M tokens as a reference for internal approval.
- Budget: we can stretch to $25k/month if the POC demonstrates >= 25% cost/op performance over our current baseline.

For the pilot timeline, the existing credits run out in 14 days — a 30-day extension + additional credits would help us validate the peak behavior. Can you propose a token amount for the top-up? Also please include any guardrails you need (rate limits, ROI check-in).

Best,
Emma Li
Product Lead, Parcellytics
emma@parcellytics.com

---
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Li <emma@parcellytics.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Request: one-off trial credit + 30d extension for Parcellytics (DL-2027-0453)

Aditya / Marissa — Parcellytics just gave firm numbers (3M steady / peaks ~4–6M, target $900 per 1M). They can move to a $25k/month pilot if we show a 25% cost/perf win. Current credits expire in 14 days; they need a full 30-day extension and more tokens to exercise peak traffic.

Ask: approve a 1,000,000 token one-off credit top-up and extend their trial window by 30 days. Conditions I propose:
- Credit is for inference tokens only (no embeddings).
- Mid-pilot checkpoint at day 14: Parcellytics must share a short metrics export (latency percentiles, tokens consumed by route, cost per 1M estimate).
- We add a soft rate cap (protects capacity) and will monitor for abnormal spike patterns.

Related: HubSpot deal DL-2027-0453: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/453/overview. Pilot plan and suggested guardrails in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-parcellytics-eval

If approved, I’ll confirm to Emma and push updated guardrails into the project folder. Thanks — Ben

---
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: one-off trial credit + 30d extension for Parcellytics (DL-2027-0453)

Ben — approved with conditions below. Good ask and reasonable guardrails.

Approval: one-off credit of 1,000,000 inference tokens. Extend trial window +30 days from current expiry.

Conditions & notes:
1) Usage restriction: credit usable for standard (FP16/Q4) inference only — explicit exclusion for experimental high-cost models.
2) Monitoring: enable token alerts at 80% and 100% of the credit. Marissa, please add a billing watchlist for this deal and ensure we get notifications.
3) Mid-pilot check-in scheduled (Day 14) — Parcellytics must provide exported metrics (latency p50/p95, tokens by route). If we see sustained overage patterns that look like abuse, we reserve right to pause.
4) Business ask: if Parcellytics wants an enterprise discount after the pilot, require a usage commitment (>= 10M tokens/month) and an expected contract cadence.

Ben — please document approval (approval_note.pdf) in the Drive folder and send an email to Emma summarizing the conditions.

— Aditya
Aditya Rao
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Parcellytics — trial extension & one-off credit confirmed

Hi Emma — good news: we approved a one-off credit and a 30-day extension. Summary below so you have it in writing:

What we granted:
- One-off credit: 1,000,000 inference tokens added to your trial allocation.
- Trial extension: +30 days from current expiry.

Important conditions:
- Credit is only for standard inference (FP16 / quantized path) — not for experimental or higher-cost model variants.
- Monitoring: we have set token alerts at 80% and 100%. We’ll ping you if usage approaches the cap and schedule a brief sync if we see unexpected patterns.
- Mid-pilot check-in on Day 14: please export p50/p95 latency and tokens-by-route to the Drive folder. That output helps our Optimize team provide configuration suggestions.

Next steps for Parcellytics:
1) Confirm the daily peak expectation as either ~4M or ~6M so we can recommend cache settings.
2) Upload a short list of the model variants you plan to test into the Drive folder.
3) We’ll enable the credit and send a follow-up with the exact timestamp when it’s active.

If Tim or your finance team wants a modeled $/1M across our three optimization tiers (standard / cached / quantized), we’ll put that together this week.

Thanks — excited to see the pilot validate your baseline.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
